text:
katie: heads up — deployed RBAC trim for keystore roles in eu-west at 04:15. immediately seeing mtls handshakes failing for ingress proxies.

omar: checking alerts, mtls_fail_rate spiked ~04:18. log link: https://logs.internal/redwood/eu-west?query=handshake

lee: oncall; pulled audit logs. I see RoleBinding change at 04:14 and a series of KMS UnwrapDenied errors for svcaccount:ingress-proxy between 04:16-04:19.

infra-bot: deploy:rollback suggested because cert fetch failing; runbook recommends rollback on keystore unwrap denies.

katie: pasted sanitized proxy log snippet:

```
proxy.ERROR: failed to load cert from keystore: unwrap error: AccessDenied
k8s.audit: RoleBinding "keystore-reader-eu" modified - removed subject svcaccount:ingress-proxy
kms.ERROR: UnwrapDenied principal arn:aws:iam::123...:role/keystore-eu
```

omar: looks like RBAC change removed permission that maps to KMS Unwrap. our policy generator maps 'keystore:unwrap' -> IAM kms:Decrypt+kms:GenerateDataKey? we need to be explicit.

lee: mitigation — reverting RBAC change in eu-west now (`git revert d2c4a5` + rollback). ETA ~4m. Also throttling proxy restarts to avoid thundering herd.

infra-bot: rollback started id=rb-eu-231 user=lee ETA=4m

katie: note for postmortem: we rolled keystore scopes down without confirming envelope key flows used by proxies. that bit is easy to miss when auditing permissions.

omar: propose quick fixes: 1) add Unwrap to the minimal proxy role, 2) update the RBAC generator to include explicit 'keystore:unwrap' mapping, 3) add a CI mtls smoke test that runs a short handshake and cert fetch before RBAC PR merge.

lee: agree; also add an audit rule: trigger pager if KMS UnwrapDenied > 5 in 5m for any region.

security-bot: incident created SEC-4012 labels [rbac,kms,mtls,eu-west] assigned to @omar.

infra-bot: alert cleared — handshake rates back to baseline after rollback (04:22).

katie: I'll open the RBAC PR patch with minimal Unwrap and an integration test stub. pinging @devex for guidance on the lightweight mtls test harness.

omar: I'll draft the postmortem note and schedule a short retro with platform + security.

lee: running rolebinding diff across clusters as a precaution and will share mismatches.

katie: thanks. lesson: keystore permission semantics (unwrap vs decrypt) must be explicit in RBAC docs and tests.
